About the Series

Precious Fix My Life

Self-help written for real people — not for the guru-obsessed or the chronically motivated. Just people who want their lives to work better, starting today.

Why These Books Exist

Most self-help books are written by people who've never lived a normal life. They're written from a stage, not a kitchen table. Precious Fix My Life was created to give practical, immediately usable guidance — backed by real research, delivered without the fluff.

Each book in the series tackles one major area of life: mindset, time, relationships, money, and habits. You can read them in any order, or start with whatever area feels most urgent right now.

What's Inside Each ebook

  • No filler. Every chapter serves a purpose.
  • Actionable frameworks. Not "just try harder" — actual systems you can implement today.
  • Real exercises. Written exercises, checklists, and 21-day plans you can start immediately.
  • Honest language. No toxic positivity. No life-hack culture. Just honest guidance.

The Author

Precious Fix My Life is a self-help series built for people who are serious about creating real change — not through inspiration, but through action. Every book is researched, structured, and written to be as practical as possible.
